# Print Trek — llms.txt

> Print Trek is a precision 3D lab in Chennai building 3CM deep matte black
> shadow frames for anime walls. HueForge layered, gallery matte finish,
> hand-finished and QC'd one by one, shipped worldwide tracked in a hard box.

## Frames

Shadow Frames are 3D-printed relief wall art, 15x20cm, 3CM deep, matte black.
Layer height 0.16mm. Designs are original Print Trek interpretations, not
licensed merchandise. Custom Lab frames are made from customer-owned artwork.
